Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
Does Teresita lose her +1 intercept if the acting vampire changes sect before the action resolves?

If yes, what about cards like Ministry and Protection Racket?

> Teresita, the Godmother
> Sabbat: Teresita gets +1 intercept against Camarilla vampires. Black Hand. Seraph.
>
> Protection Racket
> Reaction
> Requires an anarch.
> +1 intercept, with an additional +1 intercept if the acting vampire is titled.
>
> Ministry
> Reaction
> Cost: 1 blood
> Requires a Black Hand vampire. Do not replace until after this action.
> +2 intercept, +3 intercept instead if the acting vampire is Sabbat. Lock this vampire after action resolution if he or she did not block this action.
>

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Whisker wrote:
> Red Question played mid-action?
>
Teresita, the Godmother; if a Camarilla vampire is acting, Teresita has +1 intercept until the acting changes sect.

Protection Racket: if the acting vampire has a sect-related title and manages somehow to change sect, the Protection Racket will then provide only 1 intercept.

Ministry: if the acting vampire is Sabbat, the card will provide +3 intercept until the acting vampire changes sect, in which case the card will provide only +2 intercept.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
